reviews.text: Captain was great, snorkeling spot amazing. Booking it was a nightmare though – their form errors out at the payment step every time.
Ah yes, the famous 'island time' – boat left 1h20 late and nobody told us why. Loved standing on the dock in the sun.
Called the number on their site three days in a row. Voicemail full.
Best day of our honeymoon. [person] and the crew made it unforgettable. Book them!!
Instructions said meet at 'the marina' – there are two. Ended up at the wrong one, no pin, no address on the confirmation.

reviews.evidence: Great trip, but the online reservation form crashes during checkout.
Departure delayed well over an hour without any explanation to guests.
Phone line unanswered for days and the mailbox could not take messages.
Crew made the honeymoon outing exceptional; strong recommendation.
Meeting point was ambiguous; confirmation lacked exact location details.
